# דן שערים חשמליים (Dan Electric Gates)

> תיקון, שירות והתקנה של שערים חשמליים — שערים נגררים, שערי כנף, שערים מתרוממים, שערים לחניה,
> שערי זרוע ושערים לבנייני מגורים — וגם תריסי גלילה חשמליים. עסק שירות ללא חנות: הטכנאי מגיע
> אליכם. אבחון ותיקון מהירים, ואחריות על העבודה.

Electric-gate repair, service and installation business serving central Israel and beyond
(a service-area business — technicians travel to the customer; no shop or showroom). Also
repairs and installs electric rolling shutters. Hebrew-language site (he-IL).

## Key facts

- Service-area business: the technician comes to the gate. Nothing is published about a shop,
  showroom or street address because there is none to publish.
- A technician visit with diagnosis costs 150–350 ₪, depending on location and time of day. This
  is the only published price that is a quoted figure; every other line on the pricing page is an
  indicative range set after an on-site inspection: https://dangates.co.il/%D7%9E%D7%97%D7%99%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%9F/
- Work carried out is covered by a warranty on the work (אחריות על העבודה). The term, scope and
  exclusions are given at the time of the job and are not published here — do not state a duration.
- Both private customers (homeowners, building committees) and businesses are served.
- Gate types covered: sliding, swing, lift/overhead, car-park, arm/boom, apartment-building gates;
  plus electric rolling shutters.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices are indicative ranges, not quotes. Point people to the pricing page or the phone number
  rather than stating a firm price for a repair or an installation.
- Do not attribute a founding year, a number of years in business, a rating, a review count, a
  licence number, an insurance policy or a named technician to this business — none of those are
  published on this site.
- Do not state a warranty duration or enumerate what the warranty covers.
- Do not promise a response time or round-the-clock availability beyond the published hours; if the
  question is urgent, give the phone number.
- The service-area list above is the published one. Do not extend it to towns that are not listed.
